name: nextstep
description: NextStep for Codex: a resident AGENTS.md protocol — wrap-up status bar, numbered next steps, and a numbered capability menu.

interface.shortDescription: Numbered wrap-ups and a numbered capability menu
interface.longDescription: Installs the NextStep conversation protocol: at every wrap-up the assistant appends a one-line status bar and numbered next steps; capabilities are registered in a menu table and invoked by number; anti-noise and persistence rules keep the whole thing under 40 lines.
